newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish new car registrations up 48 pct April.
newsitem.headline: Swedish new car registrations up 48 pct April.

text.p: Swedish new car registrations rose 48 percent to 23,328 vehicles in April compared to the same 1996 period, industry group AB Bilstatistik said on Friday.

In the January to April period the number of new car registrations rose 36 percent to 74,718 cars, said Bilstatistik, the Association of Swedish Automobile Manufacturers and Wholesalers, in a statement.
The newest registered model so far in 1997 was the Volvo 800 S/V/C70 with 10,528 vehicles registered compared to 6,677 vehicles in the same period a year earlier, it said.
This was followed by the Volvo 900 S/V90 with 4,631 cars registered compared to 4,680 cars in the same 1996 period.
